summary: Identifies the coupling boundary between a carrier communication signal and the assigned primary conductor.
description: Identifies the coupling boundary between a carrier communication signal and the assigned primary conductor. A protection communication interface carries information between circuit ends or couples a communication signal to a primary line. Its signal path is different from the power-current path even when both use part of the same installation.

In a switchyard line bay, carrier-coupling equipment can connect a protection communication terminal to the transmission conductor. Fiber-based protection uses another physical path but still needs named endpoints and channel supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Carrier coupling signal” at the input and “Primary-line carrier connection” at the output. Coupling equipment requires the selected insulation arrangement.
